note: One vertical Short an episode, cut from the imported 16:9 final.mp4 (shorts-dh.mjs). from/to are seconds of the episode, on points where no line of any of the nine languages is spoken (the dubs run longer than zh-TW), and the span is 25–55 s (the site's Shorts profile); hook is the line under the picture.

shorts.hook:
官府強配三個新娘
今日成親！

債主上門搶米
她卻說：我嫁你

三天湊不出二十兩
房、地、人全歸債主

千金小姐甩出金子
他卻說：我自己賺

肥皂一塊賣三錢
可是……成親忘了！
